about.title: Ku
about.intro: {project} kya peer-to-peer okugabana fayiro pulatifoomu ey'omulembe omuggya ekoleddwa ku tekinologiya ezisaba ssaako kifo eky'amaanyi. Egatta interface ey'abakozesa ennyangu ne arkiteekiseti etali ey'amaanyi mu bujjuvu, era ekola engeri ey'obukuumi era esiimibwa ey'okugabana data nga tesinziira ku kifo kyonna eky'amaanyi. Pulojekiti yatuva era egabwa wansi wa {license}.

decentralized.title: Nettiwoluki etali ey'amaanyi mu bujjuvu
decentralized.description: Tewali server ow'amaanyi, tewali kifo kimu mwekiyinza okugwa. Abakozesa banoonya era batikkula ebintu butereevu wakati waabwe, awatali okusinziira ku indexer ow'amaanyi, tracker oba data base.

accessControl.title: Okufuga okuggula okutongole
accessControl.description: Buli muntu mwetwala okutandika nettiwoluki ye n'amateeka ge. Lambika ebifo by'abakozesa mu buli nettiwoluki: nyini, admin, omufulumya, omufulumi w'amawulire era omutikulazi. Fuga obutuufu ani asobola okufulumya, okufulumya era okutikkula ebintu.

ui.title: Interface ey'abakozesa ey'omutindo ogwa waggulu
ui.description: Interface ya media center enyangu era nnungi eri abakozesa ekoleddwa olwa pulatifoomu z'amazaala, TV ne ssimu. Tambula awatali bizibu na keyboard, embeba, gamepad oba kkontolola eya wala. Abakozesa ab'omutwe mwogu basobola okukozesa interface ya command line okuwawaabira software ng'esinziira ku server wa fayiro awatali mutwe.

dataFormat.title: Endeeya y'ebintu eyalibwa omuntu
dataFormat.description: Endeeya ya LISH esinziira ku JSON, ekikifuula okukola, okusoma n'okutegeera ennyangu. Gabana ebintu byo wamu ne metadata enyiriri, etangaalifu, abantu bonna gye basobola okukebera mu bwangu.

security.title: Okukuumirira n'obukuumi
security.description: Buli mukutu gwa peer-to-peer guzziddwa mu bukuumi, ekikakasa nti data yo eba ya kyama ng'eweereddwa. Abakozesa basobola okwekweka emabega wa VPN olw'ekifo ekirala eky'okutamanyibwa. {project} essa essira ku kukuumirira kwo mu nteekateeka.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Software esangibwa olwa Windows, Linux ne macOS pulatifoomu. Gikozese ku ekikola kyonna ky'oyagala.

download.title: Tikkula
download.description: Funa {project} olwa pulatifoomu yo. Buli kitikulwa kya bwereere era kya open source.
